neighbours.label: the token right before a 4 that the text makes predictable, in two ways: a number being copied from earlier in the text (on the token before its 4), and a counting run in digits or words whose next item is 4 ('… three,'); copies with a different digit there, and counting runs whose next item is another number, stay quiet

neighbours.notes: Found in the copy-only digit screen, then probed: copy before a 4 0.37, counting to four in words 0.28, in digits 0.23; copy with another digit 0.04, a count past 4 0.10. The same two-route profile as the held predictable-3, -6 and -8 units at layer 35 (L35/N6726-, L35/N1376+, L35/N7741-); those have copy-only feeders at layer 34.

predictions: >= 6/8 fire (counting in digits may be weaker); near misses < 0.2
